record.question: Life is what we make it.
record.explanation: Answer A: Noun clause. “What we make it” is a noun clause complementing “Life is”. Independent check: “What we make it” is the complement of “is,” so it is a noun clause/fused-relative clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
